name: Cat
limitations: Seated two-leg representation does not model a four-legged cat gait.

name: Dog
limitations: A profile drawing has one visible ear and eye; no hidden opposite-side organs are invented.

name: Rabbit
limitations: Existing generic locomotion does not guarantee a rabbit-specific bound.

name: Hamster
limitations: Cheeks are authored head coloration, without food storage behavior.

name: Guinea pig
limitations: The coat patch uses generic surface-detail deformation.

name: Budgie
limitations: Wings use existing generic flutter motion rather than species-specific flight.

name: Goldfish
limitations: Fins are surface details, never wings or flight effectors.
The engine currently has no swimming movement mode.

name: Turtle
limitations: The authored shell is a surface detail, never an egg.
Generic tissue deformation does not enforce shell rigidity or head retraction.

name: Leopard gecko
limitations: Dots are authored markings; generic foot motion does not simulate individual toes.

name: Corn snake
cues: Long coiled body with open gaps
limitations: One deformable body controller does not model vertebra-by-vertebra snake mechanics.
A forked tongue is represented as the authored mouth feature.
